verdict.rationale: Crossmint's x402 and MPP documentation covers only the payer side: agents use Crossmint wallets to pay 402-protected endpoints. Nothing in the pack shows tooling for a developer to protect their own API with HTTP 402, issue payment terms, or verify and settle incoming per-call payments. Seller-side machine payments are a fair axis for a payments-infrastructure platform, so this is none rather than na.
